# Vendored Three.js

Three.js **0.170.0** (r170), MIT licence (see LICENSE), copied unmodified from the npm tarball
`three-0.170.0.tgz`. No build step: `index.html` maps `three` and `three/addons/` here with an import map.

* `three.module.js` (from `build/`)
* `addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js` (from `examples/jsm/utils/`), used to merge static geometry

To upgrade, replace these files from a newer tarball and change the version here.
